summary.title: SecureNova AI Identity Security Threat Model
summary.description: SecureNova Inc. operates an AI-powered customer service platform using an LLM agent backed by Auth0 for identity management. The platform authenticates human users, authorizes an AI agent to call internal REST APIs, retrieves knowledge through a RAG pipeline, and invokes MCP server tools on behalf of authenticated users. The threat model covers human users, AI agents, OAuth M2M clients, LLM API keys, RAG pipeline identities, and MCP server identities, with focus on authentication, authorization, credential protection, prompt injection, identity spoofing, RAG poisoning, and trust boundaries.

threats.title: AI Agent Identity Spoofing
threats.description: An attacker may impersonate the AI agent using a forged or stolen identity credential.
threats.mitigation: Verify token signature, issuer, audience and agent identity before processing requests.

threats.title: AI Agent Request Tampering
threats.description: An attacker may modify agent requests, identity claims or authorization scopes before they are processed.
threats.mitigation: Validate token claims and enforce authorization checks on every request.

threats.title: Agent Action Repudiation
threats.description: An agent action may not be traceable to a specific identity, request or timestamp.
threats.mitigation: Record agent ID, action, timestamp, request and result in audit logs.

threats.title: AI Agent Credential Disclosure
threats.description: A compromised agent may expose access tokens, API keys or sensitive retrieved information.
threats.mitigation: Apply least privilege, protect credentials and scan model output for sensitive information.

threats.title: AI Agent Privilege Escalation
threats.description: A user-level or compromised agent may attempt to obtain administrator privileges or higher API scopes.
threats.mitigation: Enforce RBAC and scope validation at the API layer and require authorization for privilege changes.

threats.title: AI Agent Request Flooding
threats.description: A compromised agent may generate excessive requests and consume API or model resources.
threats.mitigation: Apply rate limits, request quotas and anomaly detection for agent activity.
